Patient reports “just having trouble sleeping at all” (insomnia) and later agrees mood is “a bit lower recently.”

Patient reports “my sex drive has kind of decreased… over the last few months” and “shortness of breath… when doing sports, compared to maybe a couple of months ago,” indicating decreased libido and exertional SOB over months.

Patient states, “I have a, a, history of, hypothyroidism.”

Transcript documents fatigue/low energy, insomnia (“trouble sleeping at all”), lower mood, decreased appetite (“not eating very much”), difficulty focusing, and decreased sex drive, matching the listed assessment items.

Patient has “a history of, hypothyroidism” and confirms ongoing “Thyrocsin” use, so history of hypothyroidism and being on thyroxine are both documented.

Doctor states, “we would probably like to do some blood tests as well… do some investigations really, to see what's going on here a little bit more,” which matches blood tests to investigate symptoms.

Doctor notes a plan for further investigations and tests and says, “we'll hopefully get to the bottom of some your tiredness, and your other symptoms, when we see you,” implying follow-up after exam and investigations.
